footprints.description: E-Switch 320 through-hole tactile switch, 12.45 mm square body, 2 terminals on a 2.54 mm grid
footprints.note: 320.04E11GRYVERT.pdf p.1 PCB LAYOUT (holes 1 and 3 dia 1.22 on a 2.54 grid; 2 dia 1.00 alignment pins not drawn) and bottom view (alignment pin 2.42 from two body edges, pin 1 7.62 from it, pin 3 2.54/5.08 from it): the hole grid is centred on the 12.45 square body. Datasheet terminal 3 is pin 2 here. Pad 1.7 x 1.22 = 2.05.

footprints.description: E-Switch GS through-hole sealed tactile switch, 7.20 mm square body, 7.62 x 5.00 mm holes
footprints.note: GS%20Series.pdf p.1 GS P.C. MOUNTING (4 holes dia 0.90, 7.62 x 5.00) and top view (terminals 1, 3 top, 2, 4 bottom). Pad 1.7 x 0.90 = 1.55.

footprints.description: E-Switch GSR right-angle through-hole sealed tactile switch, 8.00 x 6.00 mm body, 2 terminals 5.08 mm apart
footprints.note: GS%20Series.pdf p.2 GSR P.C. MOUNTING (front edge at the top; terminals dia 0.90, 5.08 apart, 2.54 behind the dia 2.00 bracket-leg holes, which are not drawn) and side view (front face to bracket legs 2.00, legs to back 4.00, so body depth 6.00; terminals 4.54 behind the front face). Front view puts terminal 1 on the viewer's left, i.e. on the right in this top view. Pad 1.7 x 0.90 = 1.55.

footprints.description: E-Switch TL1018 SMD tactile switch, 3.05 x 2.60 mm body, 1.65 mm pitch
footprints.note: TL1018.pdf p.2 Recommended PCB Layout (outer 3.80 x 2.30, inner gaps 2.50 x 1.00, so pads 0.65 x 0.65 at 3.15 x 1.65; terminals 1, 2 top, 3, 4 bottom). Body 3.05 housing (3.50 over terminals) x 2.60 (2.60 +/- 0.30). The ground-terminal option (TL1018AAB…, p.3) adds ground pads 5 and 6 between the rows; they are not switch terminals and are not drawn.

footprints.description: E-Switch TL3340 right-angle SMD tactile switch, 4.00 x 2.55 mm body, 3 terminals (1 and 3 common)
footprints.note: TL3340.pdf p.1 P.C. MOUNTING (terminal row: outer 3.20, terminals 1, 3 0.75 wide with 1.70 between, terminal 2 0.60 wide, all 1.80 long, ending on the peg-hole line; bracket pads 2x 0.90 high and dia 0.90 peg holes not drawn), side view (pegs 1.20 behind the front face; body depth 3.40 - 0.85 actuator = 2.55). Front edge at the bottom. Schematic: terminals 1 and 3 common, so datasheet terminal 3 is a second pad of pin 1.

footprints.description: E-Switch TL3360 right-angle SMD tactile switch, 6.06 x 4.37 mm body, 2 terminals
footprints.note: TL3360.pdf p.2 PCB Layout (terminals 1, 2: inner gap 2.54, outer 4.95, 3.76 long, starting 1.70 behind the front face; the 4.19-long solder pads of the bracket (5.34/8.76) are not drawn); same terminal pads p.3 (without solder pad) and p.4 (with auto placement tab). Front edge at the top. Body 6.06 wide (p.3/4 print 6.1) x 4.37 deep from the front face.
